event.description: Model FF output as input map plus rank-7 residual
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 44 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1,672 parameters/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0129, whose transpose-base plus rank-7 residual scored 0.00% at 1,669 parameters. Hypothesis: the correction rank was adequate but transposition selected the wrong shared coordinate geometry. Preserve the retained input map exactly and reconstruct output as the same-orientation input map plus the best rank-7 SVD residual, again replacing 227 output groups with 224 correction parameters for 1,669 total. This is more informative than lowering residual rank because it is the exact orientation complement at identical capacity and minimum eligible compression; all nonlinear width remains intact.
